// cat
$ cat /etc/hostname /etc/issue.net
ip-10-0-2-15
Ubuntu 24.04.1 LTS
$ cat -n /etc/hostname
     1	ip-10-0-2-15
$ cat /nope /etc/hostname
cat: /nope: No such file or directory
ip-10-0-2-15
[exit 1]
$ echo piped | cat - /etc/hostname
piped
ip-10-0-2-15

// touch, mkdir, rmdir, rm
$ touch /tmp/t && ls -l /tmp/t
-rw-r--r-- 1 root root 0 Nov 17 12:00 /tmp/t
$ mkdir /tmp/d && mkdir /tmp/d
mkdir: cannot create directory '/tmp/d': File exists
[exit 1]
$ mkdir /nope/x
mkdir: cannot create directory '/nope/x': No such file or directory
[exit 1]
$ mkdir -p /tmp/p/q/r && rmdir /tmp/p/q/r && ls /tmp/p/q
$ rmdir /tmp/p
rmdir: failed to remove '/tmp/p': Directory not empty
[exit 1]
$ rm /tmp/p
rm: cannot remove '/tmp/p': Is a directory
[exit 1]
$ rm -r /tmp/p && ls /tmp/p
ls: cannot access '/tmp/p': No such file or directory
[exit 2]
$ rm /nope; rm -f /nope
rm: cannot remove '/nope': No such file or directory
$ rm -rf /
rm: it is dangerous to operate recursively on '/'
rm: use --no-preserve-root to override this failsafe
[exit 1]
$ rm -rf .
rm: refusing to remove '.' or '..' directory: skipping '.'
[exit 1]

// cp, mv, ln
$ cp /etc/hosts /tmp/h && head -1 /tmp/h
127.0.0.1 localhost
$ mv /tmp/h /tmp/h2 && ls /tmp/h /tmp/h2
ls: cannot access '/tmp/h': No such file or directory
/tmp/h2
[exit 2]
$ cp /etc /tmp/e
cp: -r not specified; omitting directory '/etc'
[exit 1]
$ cp -r /etc/ssh /tmp/ssh && ls /tmp/ssh
ssh_host_ed25519_key  ssh_host_ed25519_key.pub  sshd_config
$ cp /nope /tmp/x
cp: cannot stat '/nope': No such file or directory
[exit 1]
$ ln -s /etc/hostname /tmp/hn && cat /tmp/hn && ls -l /tmp/hn
ip-10-0-2-15
lrwxrwxrwx 1 root root 13 Nov 17 12:00 /tmp/hn -> /etc/hostname
$ readlink /tmp/hn; readlink -f /tmp/hn; realpath /bin/ls
/etc/hostname
/etc/hostname
/usr/bin/ls

// chmod, chown
$ touch /tmp/m; chmod 755 /tmp/m; ls -l /tmp/m
-rwxr-xr-x 1 root root 0 Nov 17 12:00 /tmp/m
$ chmod u-x,go= /tmp/m; ls -l /tmp/m
-rw------- 1 root root 0 Nov 17 12:00 /tmp/m
$ chmod +x /tmp/m; ls -l /tmp/m
-rwx--x--x 1 root root 0 Nov 17 12:00 /tmp/m
$ chmod 1777 /tmp/m; ls -l /tmp/m
-rwxrwxrwt 1 root root 0 Nov 17 12:00 /tmp/m
$ chmod bad /tmp/m
chmod: invalid mode: 'bad'
[exit 1]
$ chown www-data:www-data /tmp/m; ls -l /tmp/m
-rwxrwxrwt 1 www-data www-data 0 Nov 17 12:00 /tmp/m
$ chattr -ia /tmp/m

// paths

x
/usr/bin
